verses.text: Ee \nd Bwana\nd*, Mungu wangu, ninakukimbilia wewe,
Ee \nd Bwana\nd*, Mungu wangu, kama nimetenda haya
au ikiwa nimemtenda uovu aliye na amani nami,
Amka kwa hasira yako, Ee \nd Bwana\nd*,
\nd Bwana\nd* na awahukumu kabila za watu.
Ngao langu ni Mungu Aliye Juu Sana,
Yeye aliye na mimba ya uovu
Nitamshukuru \nd Bwana\nd* kwa ajili ya haki yake,
